name: Elegant Tarantula-hawk Wasp
desc: Elegant Tarantula-hawk Wasp (Pepsis menechma): eats plants or other primary food sources. Recorded 3 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Pepsis menechma, the elegant tarantula hawk, is a species of spider wasp in the family Pompilidae, widely distributed from North America through South America.
